# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with upstream correctness fixes. Linux applications relying on fontconfig fallback should review the changed fallback-face selection behavior before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now prefers Fontconfig's FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path. Applications requiring deterministic text metrics or glyph selection should specify an explicit family and style or bundle their typeface.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates upstream bug, correctness, and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

Improves the Windows native HarfBuzz build by scoping compiler warning suppression to the bundled library.
